entries.source: The Altium Customer Experience Improvement Program ("Program") is designed to enhance our understanding of how our
entries.translation: Altium客户体验改进计划（“计划”）旨在加深我们对客户如何使用Altium产品与服务的了解

entries.source:
The Altium Customer Experience Improvement Program ("Program") is designed to enhance our understanding of how our customers utilize Altium products and services. Information about your computer and how you use our software will be sent periodically to Altium servers for analysis without any interruption to you.
 
Be assured that:
    • No design or IP information is collected as part.
    • The data we collect cannot be used to recreate your work or your products and designs.
    • The data is transmitted via a secure connection, it does not contain any information that can identify you or your company to any third party, and it will not be meaningful to anyone outside of Altium.

You can change your preferences and choose to stop sharing this information at any time.
entries.translation:
Altium客户体验改进计划（“计划”）旨在加深我们对客户如何使用Altium产品与服务的了解。有关您的计算机以及您如何使用我们软件的信息将定期发送到Altium服务器进行分析，不会对您造成任何干扰。
 
请放心：
    • 不会收集任何设计或IP信息。
    • 我们收集的数据无法用于重建您的工作、产品或设计。
    • 数据通过安全连接传输，不包含任何可向任何第三方识别您或您公司身份的信息，且对Altium以外的人员没有任何意义。

您可以随时更改偏好设置并选择停止共享此信息。
